reviewItem.question: For "Service connections that use `Direct-Server-Return` and were established prior to Cilium v1.13.3 will be disrupted, and need to be re-established", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: which live service connections use Direct-Server-Return and were established while the cluster ran a Cilium version prior to v1.13.3

proposed.statement: Service connections that use Direct-Server-Return and were established prior to Cilium v1.13.3 will be disrupted by the upgrade to Cilium 1.16.0 and need to be re-established.
